title: Hot Ukrainian Beef Stew
description: A spicy, chewy one-pot beef stew with a tangy soured cream chive dip and glaze, perfect for a comforting gluten-free dinner.
instructions: Heat olive oil in a large pot over medium-high heat.
Add beef cubes and brown on all sides, about 5-7 minutes.
Transfer browned beef to a plate; set aside.
In the same pot, sauté onions, garlic, carrots, and celery until vegetables soften, about 5 minutes.
Stir in tomato paste, paprika, cumin, and hot sauce, cooking for 1 minute until fragrant.
Return beef to the pot, pour in beef broth, bring to a boil, then reduce heat, cover, and simmer for 90 minutes, stirring occasionally.
After simmering, check seasoning and add salt and pepper to taste.
While the stew is finished, whisk soured cream, chopped chives, and lemon zest in a small bowl to create a chive dip.
Ladle hot stew into bowls and drizzle a thin glaze of the chive dip over each serving.
Serve immediately, optionally garnishing with extra chives.
